title: Follow
description: Rides the creation lines: the eye trails the strand heads along the build front (look-at lag 0.2 s), close while the type is being drawn, a little further out between words, and settles into a composed hold on each formed word before leaving with the strands again. Test chain (planar): SIGNAL, twist, BENDS, circuit board, FLOW, all roughly facing the viewer (13.8 s). Applied: whole chain: eye trails the strand heads and settles on each formed word; default camera elsewhere. Eye speed median 99 px/s (min 45, max 180 outside declared rests); heading jump max 1.8 deg/frame, view turn max 1.9 deg/frame, roll max 0.50 deg/frame; 170 declared rest frames; gates pass. Turn governor: not needed. Frames empty (<0.4% covered): none; filled (>55%): 8.0-8.4s, 8.8-9.4s; max cover 66%.

title: Orbit even
description: Constant-radius orbit around the word, look locked on the pivot, constant angular rate: an even swing of about 100 degrees that passes square-on to the word at the middle, the parallax of the strands against the type doing the work. The follow before it arrives at the start of the arc. Test chain (depth): tilted SIGNAL, twist, BENDS on a wall, circuit board, FLOW on the floor, wall and floor joined at a crease (14.5 s). Applied: around the wall word BENDS; default camera elsewhere. Eye speed median 233 px/s (min 36, max 709 outside declared rests); heading jump max 2.5 deg/frame, view turn max 1.8 deg/frame, roll max 1.20 deg/frame; 189 declared rest frames (ease-to-rest turn at 9.15 s, 11.97 s, 9.42 s); gates pass. Turn governor: max lag 0.44 s, slowed 2.2 s. Frames empty (<0.4% covered): 14.1-14.4s; filled (>55%): none; max cover 35%.

title: Spin read spin
description: Fast spin round the word so that it lands face-on as it forms, a slow drift while it is read, then a fast spin on as it deconstructs. Pivot-locked at constant radius; every next spin runs the other way. Test chain (planar): SIGNAL, twist, BENDS, circuit board, FLOW, all roughly facing the viewer (13.8 s). Applied: all three words, directions alternate (+ - +); default camera elsewhere.
